snippet.title: Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand introduces an all-new standalone wave defense experience, delivering thrilling, highly-replayable Company of Heroes gameplay designed to bring you straight to the action, either alone or with a friend.

Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand will launch on July 29 on PC via Steam alongside the 2.5.0 Update for Company of Heroes 3.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4836540/Company_of_Heroes_3_Final_Stand/
